name: B10-0321/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation on Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1093 of 22 May 2025 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards a list of countries that present a low or high risk of producing relevant commodities for which the relevant products do not comply with Article 3, point (a)
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its new rules that sort countries into low-risk and high-risk groups for deforestation. The Parliament says the rules rely on old data, ignore forest damage and regional differences, and are unclear about how countries are judged. It wants the system rebuilt with fresh data, regular reviews and fairer consultation with producing countries. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change the rules.

- The Parliament asks the Commission to scrap its country risk list and rewrite the method.
- It affects countries exporting goods linked to deforestation, and companies checking supply chains.
- Next, the Commission must respond; the Parliament also wants regular reviews and support for producer countries.
